threshold_rationale: A threshold of 0.85 was established based on Indian regulatory compliance (IRDAI/RBI) for insurance underwriting and KYC straight-through processing (STP). Any field scoring below 0.85 indicates handwritten ambiguity, non-standard date formatting, or high-risk underwriter designations (e.g. non-standard nominee relationship or cursive agent signatures) that present operational or legal risks if processed without human verification.
